messages:
Maria: pushed a tiny PR that repacks a couple proto fields to preserve stable jsonnames downstream — PTAL when you get a minute: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/4921
Devon: looking now, will skim in a bit :eyes:
Samir: quick heads-up, CI shows gofumpt diff on one file even though `make fmt` passed for me earlier. likely trailing comma/gofumpt rule.
Maria: ah — I ran `gofumpt -w` locally but didn't catch that. here's the failing chunk in case it's useful:
```diff
-  Metadata map[string]string `json:"metadata"`
+  Metadata map[string]string `json:"metadata",omitempty`
```
Ashley: hmm that diff is weird, the json tag change shouldn't be necessary. can you paste `gofumpt -v` output?
Maria: output: `gofumpt v0.3.0` on my laptop. CI runner uses v0.4.1 per the actions image. I think the rule tightened.
Devon: ok that explains it. options: pin the CI tool to 0.3, or update local dev env. I'd prefer updating the code to match v0.4 — fewer surprises later.
Samir: I can push a one-line cleanup to match v0.4, unless you want to do it, Maria.
Maria: if you don't mind Samir that'd be great. also can we avoid changing json semantics — just formatting tag ordering.
Samir: yea just a formatting tweak, no functional change. will push in a few mins and re-run `make fmt` with v0.4 locally.
ci-bot: action/format-check ran — gofumpt v0.4.1 detected formatting diff in `pkg/config/types.go` (1 file)
Devon: after Samir's fix, can one of us approve? I'm out for the 1pm sync but can review before then.
Ashley: I'll do a quick pass after Samir pushes. if it's purely formatting I'll add an approval and merge window it into the midday slot. :+1:
Maria: thanks all — one small ask: can we add a note in the PR description that this is purely gofumpt alignment so product reviewers aren't worried?
Samir: done, added a line and the small commit. CI retriggered and now green.
ci-bot: checks passed (unit, format, integration).
Ashley: LGTM — approving now.
Devon: approved from me too, nice and tiny.
Maria: incredible, thanks. merging in the noon batch. :tada:
Devon: tiny follow-up: can we add a short devx note in the contributors doc about the exact gofumpt version we run in CI so folks don't get bitten? suggest adding `tools.md` entry.
Maria: +1 on documenting. I'll open a separate tiny PR for that after this lands.
Samir: sounds good — happy to review that one.
Ashley: thanks everyone, quick and clean.
